releaseNotes:
# Hubble 2.0.15

- Typing into the blank Button Matrix row creates a complete editable button
  immediately. Further edits stay usable while saves are pending.
- Advanced actions use the module's contextual choices, named routing groups and
  compound values, matching the Matrix editing workflow.
- Ross OGP, AJA KUMO, Evertz Quartz and Blackmagic Videohub share offline blue SRC
  and purple DST values, readable highlighted text and quieter incomplete drafts.
  Routing and feedback updates avoid repeated configuration and snapshot work.
- CCC retains camera readouts while cameras are enabled or disabled and allows
  slower recording feedback before a queued Stop.
- TALLY Switch restores ON AIR row highlights, including during editing and saves.
- Companion and Stream Deck layouts have a visible Show button text switch.
  Companion layout choices keep their text inside collapsed controls.
- Module-owned spreadsheets retain formulas, clipboard data, declared fill
  behavior and feedback through immediate edits and ordered background saves.
- Switching workspaces starts modules against the correct saved documents and
  preserves active module feedback in the desktop interface.
- Workspace imports keep their completion message while the spreadsheet reloads.

This optional update installs Hubble and HubDash together and preserves existing
workspaces and settings. Compatible module updates retain their independent
versions and existing update policies.
